chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qoob narrated, saying: Ali ibn Muhammad narrated from some of his men, from Ayyoob ibn Noah, from Abu al-Hasan the Third (peace be upon him) that he said:
When your knowledge is removed from among you, expect deliverance (the Faraj) to come from beneath your feet.

key_terms.الْفَرَجَ: The deliverance (referring to the appearance of the Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What is the sign that the Mahdi's appearance is near according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), the phrase 'from beneath your feet' is interpreted by Shia scholars as indicating that the Mahdi’s emergence will be sudden and unexpected, arising from the very place where the people stand, much like the earth swallowing or revealing its treasures. This event follows a period where religious knowledge is concealed or removed from the masses, marking the end of the Great Occultation (al-Ghayba al-Kubra) and the beginning of the era of Faraj (deliverance). The hadith emphasizes divine timing and the suddenness of the Imam's reappearance to establish justice after a time of spiritual obscurity.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (39) Muhammad bin Ya’qoob narrated from Ali bin Muhammad from some of his companions from Ayyoob bin Noah that Abul Hasan ar-Redha (as) had said:
“If your knowledge has been removed from among you, then expect deliverance to come soon.”
